titleEn: Count the Number of Houses at a Certain Distance II
title: 按距离统计房屋对数目 II
summary: 编号一到 n 的房屋形成一条链，并额外连接 x 与 y；在线性规模下统计每个最短距离对应的有序不同房屋对数量。
insight: 令 x<=y。若额外边无效，答案就是链上距离 d 的 2(n-d) 个有序点对。否则 x 到 y 的链段与额外边组成大小 cycle=y-x+1 的环，环两端还分别连着长度 x-1、n-y 的尾链。把无序点对分成环内、各尾链内、尾链到环、左右尾链之间六类；每类距离分布都是单点或连续区间，可在线性次数内写入距离差分数组，最后前缀求和并乘二。
pitfalls: 答案统计有序点对，分类时先数无序对并在最后乘二
应先交换端点保证 x<=y
x 等于 y 或二者相邻时额外街道不缩短路径
环长是 y-x+1，因为还包含一条额外边
偶数环的对径距离每个点对只应计一次，数量是 cycle/2
左右尾链点对经过额外边的距离是 leftDepth+1+rightDepth
距离计数总量可达约 n²，差分与答案都必须使用 long

solutions.title: 环与尾链距离差分
solutions.idea: 按单环图的六类点对分布向距离差分数组做区间加。
steps: 若 y-x<=1，直接返回普通链的距离计数
加入两条尾链各自内部的距离计数
加入环内距离计数，单独处理偶数环对径
按环上距连接点的重数，把尾链到环的距离写成若干区间加
枚举左尾深度，把到全部右尾节点的连续距离区间加一
对差分数组求前缀得到无序点对数并乘二

code.java: class Solution { private void add(long[] difference,int left,int right,long value){if(left>right)return;difference[left]+=value;difference[right+1]-=value;}private void addTailToCycle(long[] difference,int tail,int cycle){if(tail==0)return;add(difference,1,tail,1);for(int distance=1;2*distance<cycle;distance++)add(difference,distance+1,distance+tail,2);if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2+1,cycle/2+tail,1);}public long[] countOfPairs(int n,int x,int y){if(x>y){int value=x;x=y;y=value;}long[] answer=new long[n];if(y-x<=1){for(int distance=1;distance<n;distance++)answer[distance-1]=2L*(n-distance);return answer;}int leftTail=x-1,rightTail=n-y,cycle=y-x+1;long[] difference=new long[n+2];for(int distance=1;distance<leftTail;distance++)add(difference,distance,distance,leftTail-distance);for(int distance=1;distance<rightTail;distance++)add(difference,distance,distance,rightTail-distance);for(int distance=1;2*distance<cycle;distance++)add(difference,distance,distance,cycle);if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2,cycle/2,cycle/2);addTailToCycle(difference,leftTail,cycle);addTailToCycle(difference,rightTail,cycle);if(rightTail>0)for(int depth=1;depth<=leftTail;depth++)add(difference,depth+2,depth+rightTail+1,1);long current=0;for(int distance=1;distance<=n;distance++){current+=difference[distance];answer[distance-1]=2*current;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun add(difference:LongArray,left:Int,right:Int,value:Long){if(left>right)return;difference[left]+=value;difference[right+1]-=value}private fun addTailToCycle(difference:LongArray,tail:Int,cycle:Int){if(tail==0)return;add(difference,1,tail,1);var distance=1;while(2*distance<cycle){add(difference,distance+1,distance+tail,2);distance++};if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2+1,cycle/2+tail,1)}fun countOfPairs(n:Int,xValue:Int,yValue:Int):LongArray{var x=xValue;var y=yValue;if(x>y){val value=x;x=y;y=value};val answer=LongArray(n);if(y-x<=1){for(distance in 1 until n)answer[distance-1]=2L*(n-distance);return answer};val leftTail=x-1;val rightTail=n-y;val cycle=y-x+1;val difference=LongArray(n+2);for(distance in 1 until leftTail)add(difference,distance,distance,(leftTail-distance).toLong());for(distance in 1 until rightTail)add(difference,distance,distance,(rightTail-distance).toLong());var distance=1;while(2*distance<cycle){add(difference,distance,distance,cycle.toLong());distance++};if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2,cycle/2,(cycle/2).toLong());addTailToCycle(difference,leftTail,cycle);addTailToCycle(difference,rightTail,cycle);if(rightTail>0)for(depth in 1..leftTail)add(difference,depth+2,depth+rightTail+1,1);var current=0L;for(value in 1..n){current+=difference[value];answer[value-1]=2*current};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void add(vector<long long>& difference,int left,int right,long long value){if(left>right)return;difference[left]+=value;difference[right+1]-=value;}void addTailToCycle(vector<long long>& difference,int tail,int cycle){if(!tail)return;add(difference,1,tail,1);for(int distance=1;2*distance<cycle;++distance)add(difference,distance+1,distance+tail,2);if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2+1,cycle/2+tail,1);}public:vector<long long> countOfPairs(int n,int x,int y){if(x>y)swap(x,y);vector<long long> answer(n);if(y-x<=1){for(int distance=1;distance<n;++distance)answer[distance-1]=2LL*(n-distance);return answer;}int leftTail=x-1,rightTail=n-y,cycle=y-x+1;vector<long long> difference(n+2);for(int distance=1;distance<leftTail;++distance)add(difference,distance,distance,leftTail-distance);for(int distance=1;distance<rightTail;++distance)add(difference,distance,distance,rightTail-distance);for(int distance=1;2*distance<cycle;++distance)add(difference,distance,distance,cycle);if(cycle%2==0)add(difference,cycle/2,cycle/2,cycle/2);addTailToCycle(difference,leftTail,cycle);addTailToCycle(difference,rightTail,cycle);if(rightTail)for(int depth=1;depth<=leftTail;++depth)add(difference,depth+2,depth+rightTail+1,1);long long current=0;for(int distance=1;distance<=n;++distance){current+=difference[distance];answer[distance-1]=2*current;}return answer;} };
